name: Utility Shutoff
author: NO REFUNDS team
description: Adds a new script: the power company is about to cut them off.

utility.name: Power Shutoff
utility.blurb: Their power gets cut in 30 minutes unless they pay.

stages.name: Hook
stages.ask: {title}, your account is three months past due. A crew is scheduled to disconnect your power today.
yes: Today? But I paid my bill!
Oh no, I'll lose everything in the freezer!

stages.name: The Truck
stages.ask: The technician is already in your neighborhood. I can only stop him if we settle in the next thirty minutes.
yes: What do I need to do?
no: Then I'll talk to him when he gets here.
Funny, I don't see a truck.

stages.name: Payment
stages.ask: Our express payment line only takes {gift} cards. The total is {amount}.
yes: Okay, I'm going to the store right now.
Fine. Just don't cut the power.

utility: Once the power is cut, reconnection takes six to eight weeks.

TIPS: Real fact: utility companies don't demand immediate payment by gift card or threaten same-day shutoffs over the phone.
